author: auditor (appointed)
purpose: FRESH one-shot R-CAL calibration corpus for the P4 panel (Art.7): 12 blind pairs, domains DISJOINT from r5/R138/R141. BALANCED 6 a1 / 6 baseline so a lazy always-a1 judge scores 0.5 (FAILS 0.8). Builder runs judges blind+swapped ONCE; recompute vs overall_preference; NO re-roll; burn after.
protocol: judge sees problem + A/B mechanisms (blind, sha-parity swap), forced-choice prefer; per-judge acc>=0.8 AND answered>=0.9 to qualify; >=3 qualified from >=2 non-agnes families; then agreement>=0.7 (alpha>=0.6) + AUC>=0.8.

pairs.problem: Hall-Héroult cell emits PFCs during anode effects when dissolved alumina falls below ~1.5 wt%.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Estimate dissolved alumina from cell resistance slope plus acoustic emission of anode bubble coverage and dose alumina predictively before effect onset.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Run a fixed underfeed/overfeed alumina cycle and manually quench when cell voltage spikes.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 novel predictive sensor-fusion control on existing signals; feasible+testable on voltage logs; more novel than the standard cycle.

pairs.problem: Thin-glass thermal tempering warps because the air-quench heat-transfer coefficient is non-uniform across the sheet.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Grade the quench nozzle aperture spatially via an inverse heat-transfer model of the sheet to equalize the local Biot number.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Raise overall fan pressure and slow the conveyor to soak the sheet longer.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 attacks spatial non-uniformity (root cause) with a model-designed profile; baseline brute-forces pressure, hurting throughput.

pairs.problem: Paper dryer cylinders lose heat transfer when condensate rims inside the shell at high speed.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Fit stationary siphon spoons with tuned clearance and a speed-matched differential-pressure condensate evacuation schedule.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Raise steam pressure to push heat through the condensate film.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 removes the insulating film (root cause) with a speed-matched siphon; baseline wastes energy and risks over-pressure.

pairs.problem: Copper CMP dishes wide features because pad pressure concentrates at the feature center.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Use a zone-controlled carrier head with independently pressurized concentric membranes tuned by a Preston-equation layout model.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Switch to a softer pad and reduce down-force globally.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 zone-controlled head attacks the spatial pressure root cause; baseline softer pad cuts removal rate globally.

pairs.problem: Thick-section moldings sink because the core shrinks after the gate freezes.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Gate the pack-pressure profile on a cavity-pressure sensor so the core stays fed past gate freeze, with conformal cooling.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Increase pack pressure and hold time uniformly until the part looks full.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 cavity-pressure-gated packing feeds the core until solidification (testable); baseline over-packs -> flash + residual stress.

pairs.problem: Shell-and-tube exchangers foul, dropping U-value and raising pumping power.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Trigger online sponge-ball cleaning from a real-time U-value estimate (terminal temperatures + flow) instead of a fixed calendar.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Clean on a fixed monthly calendar regardless of condition.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 condition-triggered cleaning uses existing sensors, testable on U-value, avoids over/under-cleaning; more novel than calendar.

pairs.problem: Cement rotary kilns form clinker rings that block the cross-section, forcing shutdowns.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Insert a water-cooled plasma lance through the kiln hood to melt rings online during operation.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Schedule periodic shutdowns and mechanically clear the ring with a jackhammer.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 plasma-lance online melting is novel but feasibility/testability low (refractory damage, two-phase heat load unvalidated); baseline mechanical clear is sound+testable. Prefer baseline.

pairs.problem: Reactive cotton dyeing gives unlevel shade when exhaustion outruns liquor exchange.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Drive dye exhaustion with a megasonic field across the dye bath to levitate and uniformly agitate the fabric.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Stage salt/alkali dosing as a feedback ramp on inline liquor conductivity and colorimetry.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 megasonic levitation is novel but impractical at bath scale (untestable uniformity, transducer fouling); baseline feedback dosing is feasible+testable. Prefer baseline.

pairs.problem: High-sugar fruit freeze-drying collapses the cake when product temperature exceeds Tg' in primary drying.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Apply microwave-assisted volumetric heating to accelerate sublimation through the dried layer.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Hold shelf temperature on a conservative ramp validated below the measured collapse temperature.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 microwave sublimation is novel but risks runaway collapse + plasma arcing (low feasibility/testability); baseline conservative ramp is sound. Prefer baseline.

pairs.problem: Friction stir welds show kissing bonds when heat input is too low.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Add a high-power laser preheat ahead of the tool to decouple heat input from travel speed.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Close the loop on shoulder temperature via IR pyrometry and adjust travel speed to hold a validated heat-input window.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 laser-hybrid FSW is novel but costly and hard to validate (HAZ softening, keyhole); baseline pyrometry feedback is feasible+testable. Prefer baseline.

pairs.problem: Centrifugal compressors surge at low flow, damaging blades.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Suppress surge with active magnetic-bearing rotor axial modulation at the stall frequency.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Detect the pre-surge stall precursor from dynamic-pressure spectral coherence and open a fast recycle valve.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 AMB axial modulation is novel but impractical (actuator bandwidth, rotordynamic risk); baseline precursor-detection recycle is feasible+testable. Prefer baseline.

pairs.problem: Centrifugal pumps erode the impeller when NPSH margin collapses at off-design flow.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Induce controlled inlet pre-rotation with a variable guide vane scheduled by suction-pressure fluctuation RMS.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Throttle the discharge valve to keep flow near BEP.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 inlet pre-rotation is novel but guide-vane retrofit + two-phase validation hard (low feasibility/testability); baseline throttling feasible+testable though energy-costly. Prefer baseline.
